scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Bring me two
Gemstones of the
same color, and I will
change them to Gemstones
of a different color.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
请给我两颗
相同颜色的宝石原石，
我可以将它们
转换为不同颜色的宝石原石。
蓝色魔力矿石换成红色魔力矿石！
红色魔力矿石换成黄色魔力矿石！
黄色魔力矿石换成蓝色魔力矿石！

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Hah...!
You're kidding me, right?
I can't provide you with this
service if you don't
give me at least
2 {0}s!
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
哈...！
你在开玩笑吧？
如果你不给我
至少2个{0}，
我就无法为你
提供这项服务！

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I believe I can create
a total of {0} {1}s
using the {2}s
that you currently have.
What do you want to do?
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
我认为利用您目前拥有的{2}，
总共可以制作出{0}个{1}。
您想怎么做？

scripts.text: Give me as many as you can.
I want to set the amount.

[Jade]
So how many
do you want?
The maximum number
that you can enter is 100.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
那么您想要多少个？
您可以输入的最大数量是100。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
None at all?
I guess you
changed your mind...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
一个都不要？
看来您改变主意了...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Errm...
I asked you to enter
an amount no greater
than 100, remember...?
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
嗯...
我让您输入的数量
不能超过100，记得吗...？

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Errm...
You don't have that
many gems to trade...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
嗯...
您没有那么多宝石原石可以交换...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Sure, no problem.
Come back any time.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
没问题。
随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
There you go.
Feel free to come
back any time.
Hm, what's that look for?
Is there something on my face?
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
给您。
随时欢迎回来。
嗯，那个眼神是怎么回事？
我脸上有什么东西吗？
